messages:
Arjun Rao: quick postmortem follow-up re: cloud network flaps that cascaded into model-registry timeouts and auth provider failures. Need crisp owners + short timelines.
Priya Singh: I'll own the infra-level mitigations (multi-AZ failover + retry policy defaults). ETA 7 business days.
Nate Ruiz: I'll take model-registry hardening (client-side backoff, server-side queue depth limits, and better metrics). ETA 2 sprints.
Clara Gomez: I'll own vendor escalation / contracts ask + vendor contact inventory. Will also draft the SLA breach template. ETA 5 business days.
Arjun Rao: Thanks. Specific acceptance criteria for each item please so we can close the postmortem actions.
Priya Singh: For infra mitigations: 1) verify cross-AZ failover on simulated AZ loss within 30s 2) default request retries added to infra proxy (3 retries with exponential backoff) 3) new metric infra.network.failover.count emitted.
Nate Ruiz: For registry: unit + integration tests, add circuit-breaker at client with config: failure_threshold=10, cooldown=60s. Canary job that injects 10% packet loss and maintains >=99% success for normal requests. Will link issue: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4682
Clara Gomez: Vendor escalation: ask for dedicated support channel + 4hr response SLA for auth/model-registry dependencies. I'll attach previous incident timeline and request monthly health reports.
incident-bot: Created follow-up ticket: INC-FOLLOWUP-2366101234. Assigned to: Priya Singh, Nate Ruiz, Clara Gomez.
Arjun Rao: Also: token refresh audit — we saw a cluster of expired tokens during the flap. Who picks this up?
Priya Singh: I'll add automated audit that scans active tokens and flags >0.5% expired/unrefreshed in the rolling 24h window. ETA 4 days.
Nate Ruiz: Add to registry acceptance tests: simulate delayed auth (500ms+), ensure client retries to alternate auth provider if available.
Clara Gomez: I'll coordinate legal for SLA renegotiation. Also starting a vendor-contact spreadsheet and phone escalation tree.
Arjun Rao: Operational readiness: we need a 6-step verification checklist (commands + metrics) that on-call can run post-deploy and after mitigation rollout. Keep it runnable in <10min.
Priya Singh: I'll draft the verification steps and include curl commands and grafana panels to check. Example step: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://model-registry.internal/health` should return 200 in <200ms.
Nate Ruiz: I'll add a CI canary job (nightly) with fault injection and a Slack report if p99 latency >500ms or error rate >1%.
Clara Gomez: Calendar: scheduling a 90-day recurrence review for dependency incidents and a 30-day check-in for these actions. Invite sent to Eng, SRE, SecOps.
Arjun Rao: Good. Let's also add a recurring runbook review to spot patterns (auth spikes after deploys, registry timeouts during backups).
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in on 2026-06-03 17:00 UTC.
Priya Singh: I'll open PRs for infra proxy retry + failover config by EOD tomorrow.
Nate Ruiz: Starting registry tests after sprint planning.
Clara Gomez: Vendor outreach thread created: https://comm.external/vendor-support/threads/8921. Looping in Contracts.
Arjun Rao: Closing note: each owner add ETA + acceptance criteria to the follow-up ticket before EOD Friday so we can mark owner commitments. If blockers, ping me. Thanks. :thumbsup:
